verdict.rationale: Data residency or region selection is a fair question for a SaaS expense-management product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a way to choose a storage region or residency. The community items about MTurk receipt handling and email misuse concern data handling, not storage location, so they are irrelevant here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
